environment.allocation: local_serialized, device scope through existing owner
environment.external_gpu_activity: not_excluded; other cooperating jobs on other cards
environment.clock_control: not changed; fixed frequency not established

correctness.comparison: all final payload words bitwise equal to independent CPU matrix-transpose indexing; finite and 32-word guards on each side checked
correctness.input_scope: one deterministic position-unique float32 input; repeated output-element checks are not distinct random inputs
correctness.tail_scope: all N values are divisible by block256; no tail-block claim

measurement.timed_scope: default-stream events around 10 launches; may include device idle gaps during host submission
measurement.cache_policy: repeated addresses; no explicit application cache reset; runtime cache policy unknown
measurement.transfer_scope: allocation, initialization, transfers and file writes outside event intervals
measurement.throughput_scope: logical read+write bytes; not measured DRAM traffic
measurement.wave_size_note: MACA 3.5.3 headers alias waveSize to warpSize; one API observation
fixed_within_each_N: input/output base addresses within each process
measurement.changed_factor: read permutation; output values are correspondingly permuted, so this is not a semantics-preserving gather optimization
measurement.device_buffers: 64MiB input and 64MiB+256B output reused for the full process
measurement.analysis_unit: process; median of ten event batch means per case, then process median[min,max]
measurement.cache_state: no explicit application data-cache reset; actual runtime cache policy unverified
measurement.address_control_basis: Frozen source constructs a bijection and reuses the same two device allocations within a process; the CPU oracle verifies full final values. No per-instruction memory-address trace or physical DRAM placement was captured.

plan.condition: launch only after the fixed sweep passes its full oracle and completes within its device bound
plan.allocation: reuse identical input/output device addresses for every case within each process
plan.cache_policy: no explicit application data-cache reset; runtime data-cache policy unknown; fresh binary-cache directory per process

trace_summary.warmup_assignment: caller-specified initial launches then warmups ordered by raw timestamp

recompiled_flag.scope: kernel-event descriptor flag, not a count of compilation operations

limitations: Fixing the whole address set/span does not hold short-term reuse distance or active working window constant.
The experiment does not isolate transaction coalescing, caching, translation, memory partition scheduling or clocks as a unique cause.
Per-shift output permutation differs; timing ratios are not an original-operator optimization speedup.
Trace resource equality does not prove equal memory transactions; no validated cache/DRAM performance counters were collected.
Trace duration units remain unverified and no conversion was applied.
Six processes on one card are not six independent hardware devices or cross-SDK generalization.
